input: I want an app where my dog-walking customers can book and pay me. I have never built anything.

tasks.title: Read me first: assumptions and gaps
tasks.description:
This plan is a starting point and may still have gaps. Read the items below before relying on it.
The dates are suggestions meant to keep momentum. Moving one is normal, and overdue cards simply show in red.
Pacing assumed: about 10 hours a week, starting Mon 26 Oct (you did not say how much time you have). If you add your hours per week or a start date to the description and generate again, the dates will follow.
checklist: Assumption, verify: Stripe is available and supports payouts in your country How to check: Go to stripe.com and check the list of supported countries before signing up
Assumption, verify: Supabase free tier is sufficient to start How to check: Check current free-tier limits at supabase.com/pricing before you rely on them for real customers
Assumption, verify: Vercel free tier is sufficient to start How to check: Check current free-tier limits at vercel.com/pricing before going live

Assumption, verify: You will handle scheduling yourself (the app shows slots you define; it does not sync to Google Calendar or similar) How to check: Decide whether manual slot management is enough, or whether calendar sync is needed before building
Assumption, verify: Customers pay in full at booking; no deposits or subscriptions needed initially How to check: Confirm this matches how you currently charge customers
On "Set up accounts and tools": Assumption, verify: Create a free Supabase account at supabase.com
On "Set up accounts and tools": Assumption, verify: Create a free Vercel account at vercel.com
On "Set up accounts and tools": Assumption, verify: Install Node.js on your computer (nodejs.org; choose the LTS version)
On "Set up accounts and tools": Assumption, verify: Install VS Code (code editor) from code.visualstudio.com
On "Add basic privacy policy and terms of service pages": Check with a professional what your privacy policy must include for your country and your use of Stripe and Supabase
On "Set up error monitoring": Assumption, verify: Create a free Sentry account at sentry.io and verify the free-tier limits
On "Complete Stripe identity verification": Assumption, verify: verification time varies by country; check the Stripe support pages for your country's typical timeline.
For any price, rate or rule above: check the vendor or official source directly, or ask a professional for anything legal or financial.
tasks.notes:
NOT MENTIONED IN YOUR DESCRIPTION (often matters):
- Refund and cancellation policy: the app needs to know what to do when a customer cancels
- How far in advance slots are available, and how many bookings per slot
- Whether customers need accounts, or can book as guests
- Whether you need to send confirmation emails and reminders

THINGS THIS PLAN CANNOT KNOW:
- Current Stripe transaction fees in your country
- Current Supabase and Vercel free-tier limits (these change)
- Local business registration or tax rules that may apply to taking online payments

POSSIBLE CONFLICTS TO CHECK:
- "Set up accounts and tools" rests on an unchecked assumption but its first step is not a check.
- "Set up error monitoring" rests on an unchecked assumption but its first step is not a check.

tasks.title: Decisions needed: choices only you can make
tasks.description: These choices were not in your description, so they are yours to make. Each has a recommended default: accept it and move on, or swap it for your own.
checklist: Do customers need to create an account to book, or can they book as a guest with just an email address? Options: Guest booking with email only / Account required (login/password) / Both options. Recommended default: Guest booking with email only — simplest to build and least friction for customers.

How do you define available time slots — do you enter them manually, or should the app generate them automatically from a schedule you set? Options: You add slots manually in an admin panel / App auto-generates slots from a weekly schedule you configure. Recommended default: Manual slots to start — simpler to build and gives you full control.

What is your cancellation and refund policy, and should the app enforce it automatically? Options: No automatic refunds; you handle manually / Automatic refund if cancelled more than X hours before the walk. Recommended default: No automatic refunds to start — simpler, and Stripe lets you issue refunds manually.

Recommended default for frontend and backend: Next.js (React framework). Why: Handles both the website pages and server logic in one project; well supported by AI coding assistants; large beginner community
Recommended default for database: Supabase (hosted Postgres). Why: Provides a database and simple user accounts with a free starting tier; no server to manage
Recommended default for payments: Stripe. Why: Widely used, has a test mode for safe experimentation, and is supported by AI coding assistants with many examples
Recommended default for hosting: Vercel. Why: Deploys Next.js projects with minimal configuration; has a free starting tier

tasks.title: Set up accounts and tools
tasks.description:
Create the accounts and install the software you need before writing any code.
Why this matters: Nothing else can start until these accounts exist.
checklist: Assumption, verify: Create a free Supabase account at supabase.com
Assumption, verify: Create a free Vercel account at vercel.com
Create a Stripe account and complete identity verification
Assumption, verify: Install Node.js on your computer (nodejs.org; choose the LTS version)
Assumption, verify: Install VS Code (code editor) from code.visualstudio.com
Install the GitHub Copilot or Cursor extension in VS Code as your AI coding assistant
tasks.notes: Node.js: software that lets you run JavaScript on your computer, needed to build Next.js apps. LTS: Long-Term Support, the most stable version.

tasks.title: Create and deploy a blank Next.js project
tasks.description:
Depends on: Set up accounts and tools
Use a terminal command to create an empty Next.js project, push it to GitHub, and connect it to Vercel so it deploys automatically.
Why this matters: Establishes the foundation every other feature is built on.
checklist: Open a terminal and run the Next.js project creation command (ask your AI assistant for the exact command)
Create a free GitHub account and a new repository for this project
Push the blank project to GitHub (your AI assistant can show you each git command)
Connect the GitHub repository to Vercel; trigger a first deployment
Confirm the blank site loads at the Vercel-provided URL
tasks.notes: Terminal: a text-based window for running commands on your computer. GitHub: a website that stores your code and lets Vercel redeploy automatically when you save changes.

tasks.title: Set up the database schema
tasks.description:
Depends on: Set up accounts and tools
Create the tables in Supabase that store bookings and available slots.
Why this matters: The booking and payment features cannot work without somewhere to store data.
checklist: Create a new Supabase project in your Supabase dashboard
Create a 'slots' table with columns: id, date, time, max_bookings, is_available
Create a 'bookings' table with columns: id, slot_id, customer_name, customer_email, payment_status, created_at
Copy the Supabase connection keys into a local environment variables file (ask your AI assistant what that means)
Add the same keys to Vercel's environment variables settings so the deployed app can connect
tasks.notes: Schema: the structure that defines what tables exist and what columns each table has. Environment variables: secret values your app reads at runtime so you do not put passwords directly in code.

tasks.title: Decision: confirm booking flow before building
tasks.description:
Depends on: Create and deploy a blank Next.js project; Set up the database schema
Review the open decisions about guest vs account booking and slot management before writing any feature code.
Why this matters: Building before deciding wastes time if you change direction.
checklist: Answer: guest booking or accounts required? (see Decisions Needed)
Answer: manual slots or auto-generated slots? (see Decisions Needed)
Answer: what is your cancellation policy? (see Decisions Needed)
Write your answers somewhere so you can share them with your AI coding assistant

tasks.title: Add basic privacy policy and terms of service pages
tasks.description:
Depends on: Create and deploy a blank Next.js project
Create simple static pages covering how you handle customer data and booking terms.
Why this matters: Taking payments online typically requires these; check with a professional for your situation.
checklist: Check with a professional what your privacy policy must include for your country and your use of Stripe and Supabase
Write a privacy policy page explaining what customer data you collect and how long you keep it
Write a terms of service page that includes your cancellation policy
Link both pages in the footer of the booking page
tasks.notes: Do not rely on a template without checking it applies to your situation.

tasks.title: Complete Stripe identity verification
tasks.description:
Depends on: Set up accounts and tools
Stripe requires identity and business verification before you can receive real payouts; start this early as it can take several days.
Why this matters: You cannot accept real payments until Stripe approves your account.
checklist: Log in to your Stripe dashboard and go to the account verification section
Submit all required identity and banking documents
Check your email daily for any follow-up requests from Stripe
tasks.notes: Assumption, verify: verification time varies by country; check the Stripe support pages for your country's typical timeline.

tasks.title: Build the customer booking page
tasks.description:
Depends on: Decision: confirm booking flow before building
Create a page where customers can see available time slots and choose one to book.
Why this matters: This is the main thing customers interact with.
checklist: Build a page that fetches available slots from Supabase and displays them
Add a simple form for the customer to enter their name and email
Validate that the form fields are filled before allowing the customer to continue
Show a clear error message if a slot is no longer available
Test the page in your browser with sample slot data entered directly in Supabase

tasks.title: Integrate Stripe checkout for payments
tasks.description:
Depends on: Build the customer booking page
When a customer confirms a slot, send them to a Stripe-hosted checkout page to pay, then record the booking.
Why this matters: Payment is required to confirm a booking.
checklist: Verify Stripe Checkout (hosted payment page) works in your country by reviewing Stripe's documentation
Add your Stripe secret key and public key to environment variables
Write a server function that creates a Stripe Checkout session with the booking price
Redirect the customer to Stripe Checkout after they choose a slot
Create a success page that marks the booking as paid in Supabase when Stripe redirects back
Test the full flow in Stripe test mode using Stripe's test card numbers
tasks.notes: Stripe Checkout: a payment page hosted by Stripe; you do not handle card details yourself, which is simpler and safer. Test mode: Stripe provides fake card numbers so you can test payments without real money.

tasks.title: Set up Stripe webhook to handle payment confirmation
tasks.description:
Depends on: Integrate Stripe checkout for payments
Listen for Stripe's payment-confirmed event so bookings are marked paid even if the customer closes the browser early.
Why this matters: Relying only on the redirect back from Stripe is unreliable; webhooks are the safe method.
checklist: Create a webhook endpoint in your Next.js project (ask your AI assistant to scaffold this)
Register the endpoint URL in your Stripe dashboard under Webhooks
Handle the 'checkout.session.completed' event by updating booking payment_status in Supabase
Verify the webhook signature so only real Stripe events are processed (your AI assistant can add this check)
Test by completing a test payment and confirming the database updates correctly
tasks.notes: Webhook: Stripe calls a URL on your server when a payment succeeds, independently of what the customer's browser does.

tasks.title: Send booking confirmation emails
tasks.description:
Depends on: Set up Stripe webhook to handle payment confirmation
Email the customer a confirmation with their booking details after payment succeeds.
Why this matters: Customers expect a confirmation and you need a record in case of disputes.
checklist: Choose a transactional email service (Resend or SendGrid both have free starting tiers; verify current limits before choosing)
Create an account and get an API key from the chosen service
Add the API key to environment variables
Trigger an email from the webhook handler when a payment is confirmed
Include the customer name, date, time, and your contact details in the email
Test by completing a test payment and checking the email arrives
tasks.notes: Transactional email service: a tool for sending automated emails reliably; regular email accounts are not suitable for this.

tasks.title: Set up error monitoring
tasks.description:
Depends on: Create and deploy a blank Next.js project
Connect a free error-monitoring tool so you are alerted if something breaks in the live app.
Why this matters: Without monitoring you may not know a booking or payment failed until a customer complains.
checklist: Assumption, verify: Create a free Sentry account at sentry.io and verify the free-tier limits
Follow Sentry's Next.js setup guide to add it to the project (your AI assistant can help)
Confirm a test error appears in the Sentry dashboard
Set up email alerts in Sentry for new errors
tasks.notes: Sentry: a tool that records errors in your running app and notifies you.

tasks.title: Test the full booking flow end to end
tasks.description:
Depends on: Set up Stripe webhook to handle payment confirmation; Send booking confirmation emails
Walk through the entire process as a customer would, from choosing a slot to receiving a confirmation email.
Why this matters: Catches problems before real customers encounter them.
checklist: Complete a full test booking using Stripe test card numbers
Confirm the booking appears in Supabase with payment_status set to paid
Confirm the confirmation email arrives with correct details
Confirm the slot shows as unavailable on the booking page after being booked
Check that the booking appears in the admin bookings list

tasks.title: Build a simple admin page to manage slots
tasks.description:
Depends on: Decision: confirm booking flow before building
Create a private page where you can add, edit, and hide available time slots.
Why this matters: You need to control when customers can book without touching the database directly.
checklist: Create an admin page that is password-protected (a simple hardcoded password is fine to start)
List existing slots with their date, time, and availability status
Add a form to create a new slot
Add a button to mark a slot as unavailable (to block it off)
Test adding and hiding slots, then confirm the customer booking page reflects the changes
tasks.notes: You can make the admin page more secure later; a simple password is enough while only you use it.

tasks.title: Decision: ready to go live with real customers
tasks.description:
Depends on: Test the full booking flow end to end; Add basic privacy policy and terms of service pages; Set up error monitoring
Review whether the app is ready to accept real bookings and real payments.
Why this matters: Switching to live payments before the app is solid risks real money problems.
checklist: All steps in the end-to-end test passed with no errors
Privacy policy and terms pages are live and reviewed
Error monitoring is active and sending alerts
Stripe account is fully verified and live mode is enabled
You have a custom domain set up (or are happy with the Vercel URL for now)
You have tested the admin page and can manage slots confidently

tasks.title: Switch to Stripe live mode and share with customers
tasks.description:
Depends on: Decision: ready to go live with real customers; Complete Stripe identity verification
Replace test Stripe keys with live keys, deploy, and share the booking URL with your customers.
Why this matters: This is the launch: real bookings and real payments are now possible.
checklist: Replace Stripe test keys with live keys in Vercel environment variables
Re-register the webhook endpoint in Stripe live mode
Deploy and complete one real low-value test booking to confirm end to end
Share the booking page URL with your first customers

tasks.title: View bookings in the admin page
tasks.description:
Depends on: Build a simple admin page to manage slots
Add a list of confirmed bookings to the admin page so you can see who is booked for which walk.
Why this matters: You need to see your schedule without opening the database.
checklist: Fetch all bookings from Supabase on the admin page, ordered by date and time
Display customer name, email, slot date and time, and payment status
Add a simple filter to show only upcoming bookings
